user.title: Connect to the sound recognition service
user.description: Enter the address of the service (the container that runs the classifier) and its token. The token is generated at the first start and written in the service's config.yaml (api.token).

reauth_confirm.title: Token refused
reauth_confirm.description: The service refused the token. Enter the current token.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the service. Check the address, the port and that the service is running.

advice_none.title: Advice and warnings
advice_none.description: Nothing to report for the current configuration.

advice_rule.title: Adjust an advice
advice_rule.description:
{errors}
Choose an advice, the level you want, and optionally one source (empty = all sources). “Ignore” hides it; for advice about safety sounds (fire, baby, security) also tick the confirmation.

data.confirm: I understand this concerns a safety sound

add_source.title: Add a source
add_source.description:
{errors}
Camera or Raspberry Pi through go2rtc: use its RTSP address (rtsp://host:8554/name).

data_description.threshold_offset: Added to every threshold of this source (positive = less sensitive, for a noisy room).
data_description.min_volume_dbfs: Sounds quieter than this are ignored. Leave empty to use the global default.
data_description.schedule_mode: Continuous listens all the time. Scheduled listens only during the window below.
data_description.clips_allowed: Turn off to never store audio from this source.

edit_source_form.title: Edit {source}
edit_source_form.description:
{errors}
Additional time windows kept: {extra_windows} (edit them in the YAML file).

classes_pick.title: Sounds to listen for
classes_pick.description:
{errors}
Starred sounds (★) are the ones recommended as alerts. Sounds that are not listed are ignored. Applies to: {scope}

class_form.title: {class}

data.always_on: Always listen for this sound (ignore schedules)

data_description.threshold: Score from 0 to 1 above which the sound counts.
data_description.min_duration_s: The sound must last at least this long.
data_description.cooldown_s: Delay before the same sound is reported again.
data_description.min_volume_dbfs: Leave empty to use the source or global value.

data.context_boost: Threshold raise when television, radio or music is detected

error.no_sources: There is no source yet. Add one first.
error.confirm_required: This advice concerns a safety sound: tick the confirmation to hide it.
error.no_classes: No sound is enabled here yet.

service_outdated.title: The Sound Recognition service needs an update
service_outdated.description:
The service (version {version}) is older than this integration expects, so some features do not work yet. Update it, then this message disappears.

If the service is installed with the update helper, use the Update entity of the service. Otherwise run on the machine that hosts it:

`{command}`

init.title: Unused Sound Recognition entities
init.description:
{count} entities are no longer provided by the current configuration (a sound or a source was removed) and stay unavailable: {entities}.

Remove them, or keep them (for example because an automation or dashboard still refers to them)? Kept entities are not asked about again.

abort.not_loaded: The integration is not loaded; try again once it is.
